en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Rabie, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘A man from Huzayl insulted Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>. So that reached the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, so he<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Who is for this one?’ So two men from the Helpers stood up, so they both said, ‘Us, O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>!’ So they both went until they came over to Bedouins. So they asked about him, so there he was tending his sheep. So they met him between his family and his sheep. So they did not greet him, so he said, ‘Who are you two, and what are both your names?’ So they both said to him, ‘Are you so and so, son of son and so?’ So he said, ‘Yes’. So they descended and struck off his neck.

Muhammad Bin Muslim (the narrator) said, ‘So I said to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What is your<sup>asws</sup> view if a man now were to insult the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, should he be killed?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If you do not fear for yourself, so kill him’.
